client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description:
The Client ID of your app on developer.tesla.com. Home Assistant's Tesla Fleet setup
already has one: reuse it.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: The Client Secret shown beside it.

commands_per_unit.title: Commands per 1
commands_per_unit.description: How many commands one unit of the currency buys.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency Tesla bills the account in, as Tesla's dashboard shows it.

data_per_unit.title: Data requests per 1
data_per_unit.description: How many requests for a car's data one unit of the currency buys, from Tesla's pricing.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description:
The website Tesla finds your public key on, without https://: the app's Allowed Origin,
e.g. tesla.example.com.

monthly_credit.title: Monthly credit
monthly_credit.description:
What Tesla takes off each month's bill. Tesla gives every account the same, in its
currency: $10 in the US.

private_key.title: Private key
private_key.description:
The private key Tesla already knows, to reuse it: the contents of tesla_fleet.key in
Home Assistant's config folder. Leave blank and Irori makes a key of its own, which then
has to go on your website and on the car.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect address
redirect_uri.description:
Where Tesla sends you after signing in. It has to be one of the app's Allowed Redirect
URIs; the page there doesn't have to exist. Blank: https://{domain}/irori/tesla.

wakes_per_unit.title: Wakes per 1
wakes_per_unit.description: How many wakes one unit of the currency buys.
